changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now the preferred default for new text deployments; this immutable Nano contract remains available for reproducibility.
changes.summary: Marked Nemotron 3 Nano as a superseded but still installable historical text profile.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.

changes.details: The runtime image, source commit, dependency closure, adapter, and launch arguments are unchanged; only authority metadata and its resulting content digest changed.
changes.summary: Corrected the vLLM 0.20.0 authority description and pinned drift monitoring to the immutable v0.20.0 tag.

changes.details: The launch now follows NVIDIA's 256K-context, FP8-KV, FlashInfer-NVFP4 contract with no startup download or unresolved parser dependency.
changes.summary: Made reasoning serving executable by binding the pinned nano_v3 plugin from the model snapshot and NVIDIA's immutable vLLM 0.20.0 ARM64 runtime.
Applied FP8 KV and FlashInfer NVFP4 MoE settings and recorded the unsupported snapshot-pinned nano_v3 parser requirement.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark.
Aligned the legacy Nemotron candidate with the vLLM execution harness.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
